decision: Allow only REL-001 to await external evidence during the immutable v0.2.0 release run.
rationale: REL-001 requires a successfully published image digest, vulnerability scan, SBOM, provenance attestation, and GitHub release. Those artifacts cannot exist before the first release workflow runs.
consequences: The v0.2.0 release may proceed only while REL-001 is the sole requirement awaiting evidence.
The release evidence must be recorded and REL-001 marked verified immediately after the workflow succeeds.
Every later release requires all requirements to be verified before publication.
